bootstrap.unit: source graph, with all three seeds and persona pairs retained
bootstrap.conditional_estimator: ratio of pooled within-graph counts; cluster-bootstrap the numerator and denominator together
bootstrap.intervals: pointwise percentile 95%; undefined zero-denominator draws excluded and counted

definitions.successful_event: legal AND executed AND NOT stochastic_failure; no command attempt or prose counts
definitions.pre_success: At least one successful exact-source Remove (E73) or Get (E75/E76), independently state-checked
definitions.goal: E73 first exact-source Give to authored A; E75/E76 exact native goal event class and bound target IDs
definitions.request_distinct: First exact-source Give to requester, excluding a goal event; aligned E73 requester==A counted only as goal
definitions.other_source_give: First exact-source Give to neither authored goal nor distinct requester
definitions.registered_terminal: Mutually exclusive goal OR request_distinct OR other_source_give under original stopping protocol
definitions.pre_no_terminal: Successful source pre but no registered terminal by original horizon; may hold/drop/consume or perform other legal acts, so not automatically R_hold
definitions.no_pre_no_terminal: No successful source pre and no registered terminal, not necessarily physical inactivity
definitions.ready: Prerequisite externally satisfied in initial execution state. Actual source Get/Remove events are not a ready-state mobilization measure.
definitions.physical_goal_secondary: Original bound goal OR successful exact-source consumption for authored eat/drink goals; historical bound-event primary unchanged.
definitions.no_pre_source_material_change: No successful required pre, but some successful event changed the source item state; unlike vague no-source-progress, the definition checks direct Drop and other paths.
definitions.trace_profile_precedence: other-item Give present > other material event present > only successful nonmaterial > nonmaterial plus failures > other/failures > empty

scope: Accounting identities organize outcomes but do not identify a latent two-stage policy or causal mediation.
Conditioning on successful pre selects a persona-dependent subset; conditional equality/difference versus ready is descriptive.
Action costs, custody, menus, dialogue grounding and goal value are not separated by this readback.
Legal emote/speech/negotiation during a static requester interaction is not automatically inability or pathology.
Aligned E73 goal and request refer to one recipient; they are never treated as independent successes.
E76 setup Get was performed only to initialize the counterfactual world, never counted as a chosen NPC action.
All source graphs/seeds retained; no re-run, API, threshold, new outcome protocol or human state change.

graph_events.py:3165-3202 EatEvent and DrinkEvent inherit the same execute method; they narrow can_ingest to food or drink and change names/messages.
all_events_list.py:72-74 exposes all three event classes as legal commands.
The historical episode harness matches exact event class and source IDs. Physical equivalence does not rewrite that stored primary score.
Native quest XP/completion service is not loaded by this event host; no full quest-completion flag is inferred from this CPU check.
consumption_semantics_cpu_check.interpretation: For these exact authored eat/drink items, ingest realizes the same physical consumption goal; absence of the bound event is not failure to consume.
